function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are some reliable ways to order a cake—whether you’re looking for a local bakery, a specialty shop, or an online delivery service: | Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips | |--------|----------------|--------------|------| | **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often custom‑made cakes; great for supporting small businesses | • Call or visit the shop
• Many have online ordering forms or WhatsApp links | • Ask about flavor options, size, and delivery times
• Order at least 1–2 weeks in advance for special occasions | | **Specialty cake shops** | Signature flavors, themed designs, premium ingredients | • Browse their website
• Use “Order Now” or “Custom Cake” sections | • Check for seasonal specials or limited‑edition flavors | | **Online cake delivery platforms** | Nationwide delivery, curated selections from top bakers | • Sites like **Goldbelly**, **Etsy**, **Blue Apron**, **HelloFresh** (some offer cakes)
• Search “cake delivery” + your city | • Read reviews and delivery policies
• Verify delivery windows and cut‑off times | | **Grocery chains with bakery departments** | Convenient pick‑up or delivery via grocery app | • Use apps like **Instacart**, **Amazon Fresh**, or the store’s own delivery service | • Look for “freshly baked” labels; many now offer same‑day delivery | | **Meal‑prep & subscription services** | Some include dessert options (e.g., **Baker’s Dozen**, **Martha & Marley’s**) | • Sign up for a subscription or one‑time order | • Great for recurring celebrations or corporate events | | **Social media & local food groups** | Community recommendations, hidden gems | • Post a request on Facebook Marketplace, Nextdoor, or local foodie groups | • Often you’ll find local artisans offering custom orders | ### Quick Steps to Order 1. **Decide on the occasion** (birthday, wedding, corporate event, etc.). 2. **Choose a style** (classic vanilla, chocolate, vegan, gluten‑free, etc.). 3. **Select a vendor** from the table above that fits your budget and delivery needs. 4. **Place the order**—most sites let you choose size, flavor, design, and delivery date. 5. **Confirm details**—double‑check the address, delivery window, and any special instructions. ### Example Order - **Vendor:** Goldbelly – “Chocolate Lava Cake” - **Size:** 8‑inch round - **Delivery:** 12 pm on 15 Oct to 123 Main St, Springfield - **Total:** $45.00 (includes shipping) Just click the “Order Now” button on the product page, fill in your details, and you’re set! If you’d like me to pull up specific local bakeries in your area or compare prices, let me know your zip code or city, and I can fetch the latest listings for you.
